title: 2026 F-gas sales certificate and five-year records QA

sources.title: Selling F gas in cylinders or equipment
Fluorinated gas (F gas): guidance for users, producers and traders

facts.source_fact: Cylinder sales for specified installation, servicing, maintenance or repair uses require customer company certification and individual qualifications checks.
facts.expected_handling: Require both certification layers where applicable.

facts.source_fact: Covered uses include stationary refrigeration, air-conditioning, heat pumps and fire protection equipment.
Refrigerated truck and trailer units are within the specified sales-check scope.
Certain mobile air-conditioning equipment in vehicles below the stated weight/seat limits is included.
A person without F-gas qualifications may collect, transport or deliver F gases.
facts.expected_handling: Do not extend work qualification rule to mere delivery.

facts.source_fact: Seller records must include the customer's certificate number.
Seller records must include quantities of F gases purchased.
These sales records must be kept for at least five years.
Records must be shown to the regulator when requested.
Selling to a buyer without the correct qualifications or certificates can attract a civil penalty.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve enforcement consequence without inferring penalty amount.
